policy: Shared set placement/size/spacing, per-color ink geometry and native palette residual fit on calibration cards only. Frame normalization is frozen and independent of the mana fit. Colored glyph shape uses filled-area overlap at three thresholds; native cost validation uses independent JS lettering metrics and two fixed crops. Existing reserved names are repeated validation, not a fresh holdout. All 316 set cards replayed; 276 cost-bearing cards scored. Changes outside the fixed cost crops are restricted to actual inline mana drawing bounds. No per-card renderer offsets.

darkNumerals.selection: Original ARN symbols, numeric collector number; dagger printings retain the large normal bubbles. Unknown collector conservatively retains the common style.
darkNumerals.limits: Alpha and pigment are weakly identifiable from scans; this is a rendering approximation. Per-material cal-only fit excludes Aladdin’s Lamp because its old capture contained Oracle 10. Original cost corrected to two 5 symbols before final native geometry fitting.

fullCardDiagnostic.policy: Fixed existing application whole-card structural index, same weights and original inputs on both sides. Native rasters, frozen scan poses, ten unresolved scans excluded. Credits retain the existing unverified-credit exclusion. Similarity indices are not correctness percentages or complete-set certification; mana shape also has independent filled-area and native region checks. Some legacy frame diagnostic rectangles overlap inline mana, so those aggregate metrics can move despite exact per-symbol pixel isolation. Hosted graphs are not updated by this local report.

originalCostCorrections.reason: Reviewed original printed cost; the baseline contains the previous Oracle cost.

paletteDiagnostic.policy: Native paper-cluster RGB distance on repeated validation; old fitted geometry with original palette vs final native candidate. Fixed nominal circles independently defined by each shared profile; no per-card re-centering. Weak/unseparated clusters excluded. This diagnostic is affected by source antialiasing and is not a perceptual color score.
